summary: Innventure, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the accelerated retirement of CEO and Class I director Gregory W. Haskell, effective September 1, 2026, earlier than the previously announced October 1, 2026 date. The board appointed Dr. William Grieco as CEO and Class I director effective the same date. Consulting and employment agreements were amended to start September 1 instead of October 1. Additionally, CFO David Yablunosky's departure was announced. Haskell's retirement was not due to any disagreement. The transition appears orderly, with no stated financial terms. Watch for potential strategic direction shifts under new leadership.
